source_caption_text:
One night, decades of West Coast hip-hop history 🎤

This past weekend, everyone was talking about FX’s The Drop: A Snowfall Saga and UPROXX’s takeover of Long Beach’s world famous VIP Records. “The Legacy Of LA Hip-Hop” featured a headlining performance from @kalan.frfr and special guests @andretroutman and @DJHED.

Watch the video and relive the celebration of the past, present, and future of West Coast hip-hop 🎥 FX’s The Drop is now streaming on @hulu #FXPartner
